title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=sin\left(x^2\right)$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{0.4-0}{4}=0.1$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$0$$, $$0.1$$, $$0.2$$, $$0.3$$ and $$0.4$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$S_4=\frac{1}{30} \left(f{\left(0\right)}+4f{\left(0.1\right)}+2f{\left(0.2\right)}+4f{\left(0.3\right)}+f{\left(0.4\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$0.021$$.
